notes.title: BELLATORES CBT Has Begun!
notes.content:
Hello, this is BELLATORES.



The BELLATORES CBT has officially started! 



We're providing you with a guide to the main content schedule during the CBT period, so please refer to it as you play.



\[CBT Schedule]

 - July 30th (Wed) 14:00 KST ~ August 3rd (Sun) 22:00 KST

*Please send any bugs or feedback you find during the test to the email address below:
 - E-MAIL: bellatores@nyouinc.com



\[Main Content Schedule]
1. Fast Growth Guide NPC

 - A 'Suspicious Wizard' NPC is located in the major cities of each faction and provides guides for key content.

 - Starting August 2nd (Sat) at 14:00 KST, the 'Growth' and 'Item Purchase' functions will open.

   * Growth: Supports growth items such as achieving maximum proficiency, unlocking all content, opening all regions of the world map, and receiving high-grade items.

   * Item Purchase: Allows you to purchase additional items you need from those provided through the 'Growth' function.



2. Occupation War (Faction-based Battle)

 - Held daily at 20:00 KST in the Occupation War Zone.

 - Victory is achieved by occupying and activating the Holy Object within the occupied castle and reaching 100% occupation progress.



3. Territory War (Guild-based Battle)

 - Held daily at 22:00 KST in each faction's hunting grounds.

 - Guild leaders can apply for Territory War participation via the Territory War UI displayed on the right side of the screen, starting 10 minutes before the war begins.

 - When the Territory War starts, all guild members of the applying guild will be forcibly moved to the Territory War world.

 - Accumulate attack points by attacking the 'Heart of the Earth' (object-type monster). The guild with the most accumulated points wins (lasts for 20 minutes).

  * A minimum of 10,000 attack points is required to occupy the Heart of the Earth.



4. Boss Raids

 - Bosses appear daily at 12:00 KST, 18:00 KST, and 24:00 KST.

 - Anyone can participate without special conditions, and rewards are obtained upon defeating the boss.

  * You can check their locations on the world map.

  * Starting August 2nd at 14:00 KST, you can use movement scroll items from the 'Content Movement Scroll Support Box' provided and sold by the Fast Growth Guide NPC to move directly to these locations.



Thank you.
